text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli hasn't been in the best 
shape lately. Hoping to help her in any 
way I can, I came to the shrine, but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, I'm not praying.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a kid. It's stupid to rely on 
prayers to fix anything.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: If you wanna pray, go by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli sat down by herself in the 
shade of a tree and began reading a book 
on racing theory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There's no sign that she's coming back...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since it couldn't be helped, I prayed with 
all my heart on Sirius Symboli's behalf as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You were praying for a mighty long time. I 
wonder what you have to pray so much 
about.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Of all things, you chose that? ...Then 
this was completely pointless.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No need to pray to God, I'll grant it 
myself. I'll be back in top shape in no 
time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Sirius Symboli regained 
her form entirely on her own.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You were praying for a mighty long time. I 
wonder what you have to pray so much 
about.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to answer her words— 
My foot slipped...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Tch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something grabbed me by the waist—and 
pulled me close. Fearfully, I opened my 
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Serves you right after praying so 
desperately, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
See what I mean? You can't rely on God. 
You gotta look out for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...If something happens to you, I won't 
even be able to race.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't you go tripping in some weird place 
and making trouble for me, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sirius Symboli said, the gods 
couldn't be relied upon, as we didn't 
receive any divine blessings at all...
